ignore.title: Left out of the backup
ignore.description: Files matching these patterns stay on each computer and are kept when a sync updates the skill.
ignore.hint: One pattern per line, written like a .gitignore. They apply on all your devices. Files already backed up stay in the backup.

backupSync.removed_one: Deleted on {{device}}: {{names}}. It is in Recently removed if you want it back.
backupSync.removed_other: Deleted on another device: {{names}}. They are in Recently removed if you want them back.

conflictDiff.title: Compare “{{name}}”
conflictDiff.description: This computer's version against the one from the other device, file by file. Choose a version in the list afterwards.

review.title: Review the sync
review.description_one: The remote has {{count}} backup from another device. Here is what the sync will do.
review.description_other: The remote has {{count}} backups from other devices. Here is what the sync will do.
review.conflictsHint: This computer's version stays. Choose which one to keep afterwards, under Needs attention.
review.deletesHint: Skills deleted on another device. Deleted here, they wait in Recently removed for {{days}} days. Kept, they go back to the other devices.
review.manyDeletes_one: This sync deletes {{count}} skill here. Check it is meant to go.
review.manyDeletes_other: This sync deletes {{count}} skills here, more than usual. If the other device lost its library, keep them all.
review.manyDeletesNotPerSkill_one: This sync deletes {{count}} skill here. It waits in Recently removed for {{days}} days.
review.manyDeletesNotPerSkill_other: This sync deletes {{count}} skills here, more than usual. They wait in Recently removed for {{days}} days.
review.presets_one: {{count}} preset is updated from another device.
review.presets_other: {{count}} presets are updated from other devices.
review.notPerSkill_one: The backup remote lacks Loadout's skill details, so this {{count}} backup is merged by Git line by line and cannot be listed skill by skill.
review.notPerSkill_other: The backup remote lacks Loadout's skill details, so these {{count}} backups are merged by Git line by line and cannot be listed skill by skill.
review.noMatch: No skill in this sync fits the search and the filter.
review.stale: Skills on this computer changed since this review. Recheck to see what the sync does now.

publicRepo.title: {{repo}} is public
publicRepo.body: Anyone can read the skills you back up there, and every earlier version of them. Nothing has been saved or uploaded yet. Make the repository private on GitHub first, unless you want your skills to be public.
